Row 9 has 21 seats since it doesn't have seat 1, but the seats are still numbered the same as rows 1-8.' (Verified Feb 2026)
notes: Premium seating area as part of the Hall of Fame Club. Rows 7 and above are under cover. Amenities: wider padded seats with extra legroom, private club entrances, climate-controlled lounges, upscale bistro dining, private concession stands, two full-service bars, Cooperstown Gallery access. Review states most Hall of Fame Club sections have 8-10 rows. Sections 220-224 (behind home plate) offer the most centered views; sections 225-232 get shade earlier on the third-base side for day games - neither range includes 212. For concerts, sections 212-216 and 228-232 are noted as moving closer to the stage.
